status: frozen before any regional temperature result, thermal-stress map, v17 thermal inverse coefficient, or v17 lensing score existed
purpose: Construct outcome-blind projected gas random-stress source maps from the frozen registered baryon maps and independently fitted Chandra temperatures, before opening the spent lensing residual.

authorization.prohibition: Do not construct any thermal source if either cluster fails the frozen regional gate.

physical_proxy.response_equation: q_contrast(x)=kappa_gas(x) [k_B (T_X(x)-T_global)/(mu m_p c^2)] inside resolved bins and zero outside
physical_proxy.gas_convergence: kappa_gas=Sigma_gas/Sigma_critical using the registered baryon-map lens redshift and source redshift z_s=2.0
physical_proxy.mu_interpretation: fixed fully ionized intracluster-plasma conversion factor, not a gravity parameter

temperature_assignment.inside_resolved_bin: use that bin's primary best-fit regional temperature whether or not its uncertainty or reduced-statistic subgate passed; never select bins by fitted outcome
temperature_assignment.outside_resolved_bin: use the same cluster's primary integrated best-fit temperature for q_total
temperature_assignment.nonfinite_best_fit_rule: fail construction rather than impute, merge, smooth, or drop the bin
temperature_assignment.bin_sampling: nearest integer pixel in the frozen celestial-WCS binmap after transforming each registered baryon-grid point from the baryon-map center and physical axis
temperature_assignment.coordinate_scale: use the registered baryon map's lens redshift because its physical kpc axis was built at that redshift

feature_construction.one_metric_triplet: each smoothed scalar source generates convergence, shear_1, and shear_2 through the same E-mode potential operator

families.thermal_total: three q_total one-potential triplets at 25, 75, and 150 kpc
families.thermal_component: thermal_total plus three q_contrast one-potential triplets at the same scales

claim_boundary: This map tests whether independently observed gas random stress carries transferable spatial information; it is not a derived gravity law.
The later inverse coefficient is a diagnostic coefficient, not a universal gravity constant.
The bin temperatures are projected single-temperature plasma fits and do not reconstruct the full three-dimensional stress tensor.
The same source, scales, and one-potential operator must be used in both clusters.
No spent lensing target may be read until the source maps and their hashes have been written.
